Name: Remote Community Center
Author: armful
Description:
Other remote Community Center mods are broken in multiplayer. If you're holding an item in your cursor and another player donates at the same time, your item disappears. Gone. We fix that by restoring the held item, so nothing gets lost no matter how many people are using the menu at once.

[size=4][b]Heads up[/b][/size]
After completing a room remotely, walk into the Community Center to see its cutscene. You'll need to walk in once per completed room.
[size=1]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Luxiana3010]Luxiana3010[/url] for reporting this.[/size]
